newsitem.title: UK: Siebe up after presentation to investors.
newsitem.headline: Siebe up after presentation to investors.

text.p: Shares in Siebe Plc rose against the trend of a falling UK stock market on Wednesday as company finance director Roger Mann gave a presentation to investors in Zurich hosted by investment bank SBC Warburg, dealers said.
The stock was up 3-1/2p at 10.25-1/2 stg by 1446 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 index fell 34.5 points to 4,202.9.

A spokesman for Siebe said the meeting was part of a routine round of presentations to major fund management groups. Siebe shares have risen for the past four sessions after closing on January 22 at their lowest level since early December. They were among the top performing UK shares in 1996.
